verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local, on-device inference engine for iOS, Android, Windows and macOS, with a localhost OpenAI-compatible server. It has no hosted storage tier where region or residency selection would apply, so this cloud data-residency axis is a category error for this kind of product. The --target-dir flag only sets a local directory for downloaded model weights, not where user data is stored, and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
